name: Seated Pin Press (Barbell)
instructions: Set a barbell on safety pins at forehead height inside a rack, seated on a bench.
Press the bar from the dead stop on the pins to full overhead lockout.
Lower back to the pins and pause — every rep starts from zero.
Builds explosive pressing power from the sticking point.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: Seated Pin Press (Barbell) is an advanced pushing exercise for the front delts, performed with a barbell. Pressing strength keeps daily pushing tasks — and your shoulders — working well for decades.
